Implementation contract (short):

- Requirement -> owning files:
  - Window title "Grapple Swing": game/project.godot (run/main_scene) and window title set by engine; main.gd prints nothing; Godot doesn't set title via script so project.godot will define application/config/name (we'll set name).
  - Pendulum, release, projectile, target, score, restart, quit, rope/anchor drawing, ball image: main.gd (scene setup, drawing, score, input) + ball.gd (pendulum/math, release, projectile motion).
  - Ball sprite asset: game/ball.tscn uses res://game/assets/ball.png.
  - Console prints for RELEASE, RESTART, QUIT, SCORE: main.gd prints RELEASE/RESTART/QUIT; main.gd prints SCORE when scoring.

- State ownership and interfaces:
  - main.gd owns score:int, anchor_pos:Vector2, target_rect:Rect2, landing_check:bool, and the Ball instance reference.
  - ball.gd owns its local physics state: attached:bool, angle:float, ang_vel:float, length:float, pos:Vector2, vel:Vector2.
  - main.gd -> Ball methods: reset(anchor:Vector2,length:float) -> void; release() -> void; properties: released:bool, position:Vector2 (get via ball.global_position), exposed via typed methods/vars.

- Inputs -> actions -> state -> feedback:
  - Space action: main.gd listens; if ball.attached then call ball.release(), set landing_check=false, print "RELEASE". Visual: rope disappears and ball moves projectile.
  - R: main.reset_full() resets score to 0, reinstantiates ball attached, print "RESTART".
  - Escape: get_tree().quit(), print "QUIT".
  - Landing detection: main.gd checks each frame when ball.released and not landing_check: if ball enters target_rect (center point), increment score, print "SCORE", and reset ball; else if ball.y>viewport_height treat as miss and reset without score.

- Coordinate convention:
  - Node2D global coordinates in pixels. Anchor at (viewport_width/2, 80). Pendulum angle measured from vertical; position = anchor + Vector2(sin(angle), cos(angle))*length.

- Lifecycle:
  - init: main.gd sets up InputMap, anchor, target, adds ball instance attached, score=0.
  - play: ball swings under pendulum equations while attached; after release ball follows ballistic motion with gravity g=900 px/s^2.
  - terminal (landing): main detects landing, updates score, reinitializes ball attached.
  - restart: R resets score and ball.
  - quit: Escape quits.

var target_rect: Rect2
var ball: Node = null

    # Input actions
    if not InputMap.has_action("release"):
        InputMap.add_action("release")
        var ev := InputEventKey.new()
        ev.physical_scancode = KEY_SPACE
        InputMap.action_add_event("release", ev)
    if not InputMap.has_action("restart"):
        InputMap.add_action("restart")
        var ev2 := InputEventKey.new()
        ev2.physical_scancode = KEY_R
        InputMap.action_add_event("restart", ev2)
    if not InputMap.has_action("quit"):
        InputMap.add_action("quit")
        var ev3 := InputEventKey.new()
        ev3.physical_scancode = KEY_ESCAPE
        InputMap.action_add_event("quit", ev3)

    anchor_pos = Vector2(viewport_size.x / 2, 80)
    target_rect = Rect2(Vector2(viewport_size.x/2 - 80, viewport_size.y - 120), Vector2(160, 80))

    # Create a Label to show score in top-left
    score_label = Label.new()
    score_label.text = "Score: %d" % score
    score_label.position = Vector2(8, 8)
    add_child(score_label)

    spawn_ball()
    set_process(true)

func spawn_ball() -> void:
    if ball:
        ball.queue_free()
    ball = BALL_SCENE.instantiate()
    add_child(ball)
    ball.reset(anchor_pos, pendulum_length)

func _process(delta: float) -> void:
    # Input handling
    if Input.is_action_just_pressed("release") and ball and ball.attached:
        ball.release()
        print("RELEASE")
    if Input.is_action_just_pressed("restart"):
        score = 0
        score_label.text = "Score: %d" % score
        spawn_ball()
        print("RESTART")
    if Input.is_action_just_pressed("quit"):
        print("QUIT")
        get_tree().quit()

    # Landing and scoring checks
    if ball and ball.released:
        var center: Vector2 = ball.global_position
        if target_rect.has_point(center):
            score += 1
            score_label.text = "Score: %d" % score
            print("SCORE")
            spawn_ball()
        elif center.y > viewport_size.y:
            # missed
            spawn_ball()

    # Request redraw for rope/target/anchor visuals
    queue_redraw()

func _draw() -> void:
    # Draw anchor
    draw_circle(anchor_pos, 6, Color(1,0,0))
    # Draw rope if attached
    if ball and ball.attached:
        draw_line(anchor_pos, ball.global_position, Color(0.6,0.6,0.6), 3)
    # Draw target
    draw_rect(target_rect, Color(0,1,0))

class_name Ball
extends Node2D

@export var g: float = 900.0 # pixels/s^2 gravity for projectile and pendulum

var attached: bool = true
var released: bool = false
var anchor_pos: Vector2 = Vector2.ZERO
var length: float = 300.0
var angle: float = -0.9 # measured from vertical, negative = left
var ang_vel: float = 0.0
var linear_velocity: Vector2 = Vector2.ZERO

@onready var sprite: Sprite2D = $Sprite

func _ready() -> void:
    sprite.centered = true

func reset(p_anchor: Vector2, p_length: float) -> void:
    anchor_pos = p_anchor
    length = p_length
    attached = true
    released = false
    angle = -0.9
    ang_vel = 0.0
    linear_velocity = Vector2.ZERO
    global_position = anchor_pos + Vector2(sin(angle), cos(angle)) * length
    sprite.visible = true

func release() -> void:
    if not attached:
        return
    attached = false
    released = true
    # linear velocity from angular velocity: v = length * ang_vel perpendicular to radius
    linear_velocity = length * Vector2(cos(angle), -sin(angle)) * ang_vel

func _process(delta: float) -> void:
    if attached:
        var ang_acc: float = -(g / length) * sin(angle)
        ang_vel += ang_acc * delta
        angle += ang_vel * delta
        global_position = anchor_pos + Vector2(sin(angle), cos(angle)) * length
    else:
        linear_velocity.y += g * delta
        global_position += linear_velocity * delta

extends Node2D

@onready var viewport_size: Vector2 = get_viewport_rect().size

const BALL_SCENE: PackedScene = preload("res://ball.tscn")

var score: int = 0
var anchor_pos: Vector2
var pendulum_length: float = 220.0
var target_rect: Rect2
var ball: Node = null
var score_label: Label = null

func _ready() -> void:
    # Input actions
    if not InputMap.has_action("release"):
        InputMap.add_action("release")
        var ev := InputEventKey.new()
        ev.keycode = KEY_SPACE
        InputMap.action_add_event("release", ev)
    if not InputMap.has_action("restart"):
        InputMap.add_action("restart")
        var ev2 := InputEventKey.new()
        ev2.keycode = KEY_R
        InputMap.action_add_event("restart", ev2)
    if not InputMap.has_action("quit"):
        InputMap.add_action("quit")
        var ev3 := InputEventKey.new()
        ev3.keycode = KEY_ESCAPE
        InputMap.action_add_event("quit", ev3)

    anchor_pos = Vector2(viewport_size.x / 2, 80)
    target_rect = Rect2(Vector2(viewport_size.x/2 - 80, viewport_size.y - 120), Vector2(160, 80))

    # Create a Label to show score in top-left
    score_label = Label.new()
    score_label.text = "Score: %d" % score
    score_label.position = Vector2(8, 8)
    add_child(score_label)

    spawn_ball()
    set_process(true)

func spawn_ball() -> void:
    if ball:
        ball.queue_free()
    ball = BALL_SCENE.instantiate()
    add_child(ball)
    ball.reset(anchor_pos, pendulum_length)

func _process(delta: float) -> void:
    # Input handling
    if Input.is_action_just_pressed("release") and ball and ball.attached:
        ball.release()
        print("RELEASE")
    if Input.is_action_just_pressed("restart"):
        score = 0
        score_label.text = "Score: %d" % score
        spawn_ball()
        print("RESTART")
    if Input.is_action_just_pressed("quit"):
        print("QUIT")
        get_tree().quit()

    # Landing and scoring checks
    if ball and ball.released:
        var center: Vector2 = ball.global_position
        if target_rect.has_point(center):
            score += 1
            score_label.text = "Score: %d" % score
            print("SCORE")
            spawn_ball()
        elif center.y > viewport_size.y:
            # missed
            spawn_ball()

    # Request redraw for rope/target/anchor visuals
    queue_redraw()

func _draw() -> void:
    # Draw anchor
    draw_circle(anchor_pos, 6, Color(1,0,0))
    # Draw rope if attached
    if ball and ball.attached:
        draw_line(anchor_pos, ball.global_position, Color(0.6,0.6,0.6), 3)
    # Draw target
    draw_rect(target_rect, Color(0,1,0))
